card_notes: The released mask fills interior holes at native size (scipy binary_fill_holes), the rule the pipeline of record applies to the earlier network's output; its training labels, carried from the 3D masks of record, leave out the ventricles and the interhemispheric and transverse fissures, so the fill changes 78 % of them (12,475 of 16,078 photographs).

The earlier network's masks of MF191 and MF196 are a re-run of the pipeline of record on their current photographs, because the photo masks of record of those brains carry hand edits (11 and 55 photographs).

MF278's labels sit about half an L4 voxel off its photographs in columns, a property of its mask of record (also seen in 3D): the earlier network sits 8 native pixels off them, while the released model follows them on its own training photographs (edge shift 0 px).

The labels follow the 3D mask of record section by section (one label section per 8 photographs, 0.36–0.38 mm). Across the five cross-validation folds, 495 of the 598 held-out photographs below Dice 0.9 (of 16,078) lie in the first 80 photographs of a stack, at the frontal pole where the section changes quickly, or at the caudal end: the first photographs, and in MR253 the last 2 and MR254 the last 4 and MR256 the last 4 before the caudal cutoff, fall in a section the mask of record leaves empty, so their label is empty while the model marks the tissue they show. In MR254 the mask of record is also smaller than the tissue at the frontal pole (hand edits, the last removing the olfactory stalks): over its first 80 photographs the model's mask is 1.6 times the label (held-out Dice 0.77) and agrees better with the automatic 3D mask the record was edited from (0.89); labels sampled from the nearest section instead of interpolated give the same (0.77).

output.grid: the input image's own grid (class probabilities resampled back linearly)

inference.probabilities_back: linear, to native size (native photographs only)

postprocess_posthoc.position_band: first 80 photographs by stack index, ten label sections
postprocess_posthoc.decision: decided on 3 Nov 2026, after training: the pipeline's rule of record (code/tasks.py normalize_masks: binary_fill_holes on every mask of the earlier network at native size); reconstruction has only read filled masks

recipe.loss: Dice (foreground classes, batch) + cross-entropy; deep supervision weights 1, 1/2, 1/4, ... (lowest 0)
recipe.foreground_oversampling: 1/3 of the patches centered on a foreground voxel

data.fold_rule: 19 subjects, 16078 cases; 5 folds: subjects in numpy default_rng(2026).permutation order (from the sorted list), dealt round-robin; a subject's cases are all in one fold
